title: Consent irrelevant in POCSO cases, says Kerala High Court
content: The Court made the legal position clear while dismissing a plea by an accused challenging his conviction under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012

title: Delhi horror: Woman stabbed to death by husband at hotel, accused attempts suicide
content: A woman was allegedly stabbed by her boyfriend at a Delhi hotel. The man then reportedly consumed poison in an apparent suicide attempt. Hotel staff discovered the woman lying in a pool of blood on Thursday morning. She was taken to the hospital and declared brought dead by doctors. The accused man is currently undergoing treatment and further investigation is underway.

title: 'You guys are like a joke': Sabalenka blasts reporter on 'party' talk in tense presser
content: The defending champion rejected the suggestion that her off-court appearances had affected her preparation.

title: UP: 35-year-old man allegedly rapes neighbour's 3-month-old daughter; arrested
content: A three-month-old infant was allegedly assaulted by a neighbor in Mainpuri, Uttar Pradesh. The accused, Jetendra, was arrested by police after a thorough investigation. The incident occurred while the baby's parents were occupied with household duties. The child was hospitalized in critical condition and is currently receiving treatment. Police have registered a case and are proceeding with legal action.

title: Meta AI chief says he wants to wait for Elon Musk’s Neuralink before having kids
content: Meta AI chief Alexandr Wang plans to delay having children until brain-computer interfaces advance. He believes children's brains can adapt better to technologies like Neuralink. Early childhood offers significant neuroplasticity for integrating new interfaces. This integration could allow children to use the technology in unique ways. Wang expects artificial intelligence to become increasingly powerful and capable.

title: Accidental cricketer: Konthoujam's journey from boxing rings to first-class cricket
content: Before cricket, Bishworjit Konthoujam was a boxer who won school and state medals before making the switch to cricket. In his village, he would stop games and ask, “Ek ball karane do, please.” He had never played formal leather-ball cricket before adapting to the game. Years later, he has 147 first-class wickets and dismissed 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in the Duleep Trophy.

title: Indian Railways set to get indigenous 280 kmph bullet trains by early 2027
content: India could see the launch of its first bullet train service in 2027, with the Surat–Bilimora section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project expected to become operational by August that year.

title: Former Ukrainian defence minister launches Palantir-backed defence tech firm
content: Palantir's chief executive, Alex Karp, has stepped into the role of principal investor for an innovative defense tech firm established by former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov. This enterprise's mission is to leverage Ukraine's battlefield expertise, transforming wartime knowledge into advanced technology solutions for Ukraine and its allies, drawing from the real-life experiences of the ongoing conflict against Russia.

title: More teachers, better access, fewer pupils: India’s govt school paradox
content: The number of government schools has decreased, yet access appears better in theory. As digital connection rises, the gap between what's promised and the actual classroom experience remains glaringly evident.

title: Retired nurse loses $200,000 to fake federal agent, then gets $80,000 tax bill
content: Synopsis:A retired US nurse lost more than $200,000 after a scammer posing as a federal agent tricked her into draining her retirement accounts. The financial trouble continued when the IRS sent her an $80,000 tax bill on the money she had withdrawn and lost. Unable to pay, she sold her home and moved into a small apartment while continuing to repay the tax debt.

title: When Oracle founder said he wanted to remain friends after first wife filed for divorce
content: Larry Ellison, the visionary behind Oracle, navigated a challenging divorce in 1986, shortly after welcoming his daughter. His former spouse, Barbara, took on the vital role of primary caregiver, nurturing a passion for cinema within their children, David and Megan. This foundation propelled David to establish Skydance Media, where he produced blockbuster franchises, while Megan founded Annapurna Pictures, garnering numerous Academy Award nominations.

title: Rajasthan HC allows prosecution of constable accused of assault inside SDM court
content: The Rajasthan high court refused to quash criminal proceedings against a police constable. He was accused of illegal detention and severe assault within court premises. The court found his actions were not part of official duty. Prior prosecution sanction was deemed unnecessary for these charges. Criminal proceedings against the constable will now continue.

title: Watch: Masked men carry TVs, printer out of Kolkata TMC office after vandalism claim
content: Masked men allegedly attacked the Trinamool Congress Camac Street office early Thursday.  Visuals showed items being removed and a room damaged after the incident.  Abhishek Banerjee alleged BJP workers stormed the office and assaulted people inside.  He also criticized Kolkata Police for their delayed response to the attack.  The party demands immediate arrests and an investigation into the violence.

title: Five years after Krunal Pandya row, Deepak Hooda set to play for Baroda
content: The batting allrounder had joined Rajasthan as a professional for the 2021-22 domestic season after severing ties with Baroda. Hooda had moved to Rajasthan after being banned for the 2020-21 season in January by the BCA for "indiscipline."

title: Allahabad HC drops NSA against DU student over Noida stir, but she’ll stay in jail
content: The Allahabad high court has overturned the Noida police's detention of Aakriti Choudhary under the National Security Act, highlighting serious procedural mistakes and insufficient evidence. As a result, the court mandated a compensation of five lakh rupees for the labor activist accused of inciting unrest during a protest for better minimum wages. Choudhary is involved in eleven FIRs but has managed to secure bail in five.

title: Toxic box office Day 9: Yash film crawls towards Rs 250 cr
content: Yash's 'Toxic: A Fairytale For Grown-Ups' continues its steady second-week run, having crossed the Rs 322 crore worldwide mark by Day 8, with the film now looking to consolidate its position as one of the year's biggest theatrical performers. The Geetu Mohandas directorial is now into Day 9 since its release on August 26, 2026, with collections settling into the more modest weekday pace typical of films moving past their opening frenzy. Even so, the film continues to add steadily to its overall tally, with its worldwide gross comfortably past the Rs 320 crore mark. The film has been facing a competition from the devotional biopic, 'Hanuman Ansh' and is expected to clash with the fan-loved big screen adaption of the Amazon Prime series, 'Mirzapur: The Movie'

title: ‘Mayday emergency’: IndiGo flight diverts to Muscat after pilot falls ill mid-air
content: An IndiGo flight traveling from Doha to Bengaluru had to make an unscheduled stop in Muscat after one of the pilots became incapacitated mid-flight. A Mayday emergency was declared, resulting in a swift diversion to Oman’s capital. Upon arrival, medical assistance was promptly administered to the crew member, who is now reported to be in stable condition.

title: CJP campaign ‘sparks’ razing of buffalo-shed school in Jaipur
content: In a bid to enhance educational facilities, a crumbling primary school near Jaipur was razed on Wednesday to make way for a new building. Previously, students were crammed into a makeshift buffalo shed. This initiative, backed by the MLA Local Area Development Fund, also comes after an incident involving an inspection team's safety. Construction is underway, while classes temporarily shift to a nearby resident's home.

title: Son died in 2013, LIC rejected 5 claims over diabetes; mother wins Rs 61.5 lakh
content: The decision ends a legal dispute that continued for more than a decade. It also establishes that an insurer cannot deny a death claim for non-disclosure of a medical condition if the policyholder himself was unaware of the disease when the policy was taken.

title: Man caught 'filming' women joggers at Bengaluru Lake
content: A man was allegedly caught secretly recording women jogging at Agara Lake.  He was confronted by joggers who found videos on his mobile phone.  The man, identified as Golden Kumar, reportedly apologized and sought forgiveness.  A complaint was filed at the HSR Layout police station against the suspect.  Police will summon and question Kumar regarding the recording circumstances.

title: How Super League Kerala is trying to build Indian football from the ground up
content: As Super League Kerala prepares for its third season, the league is betting on sustainability over spectacle. CEO Mathew Joseph outlines a club-first financial model, grassroots talent development, digital innovation and global broadcasting ambitions, while introducing India's first penalty shootout-decided league format. The goal is clear: transform Kerala's football passion into a sustainable ecosystem for Indian football.

title: YouTuber Santosh Pandit detained for defamatory video against Maharashtra minister
content: Social media influencer Santosh Pandit was detained early Wednesday morning.  This action followed a defamation case registered over a video.  The video allegedly used abusive and derogatory language against minister Chandrakant Patil.  A Pune corporator, Sunil Pande, lodged the complaint with police.  Further investigation into the matter is currently underway by authorities.

title: 'Abused, thrashed with sticks': How land sale turned sons against parents in Pune
content: Two sons allegedly assaulted their elderly parents with wooden sticks in Pune district. The dispute arose from the sale of land belonging to the mother. Passersby alerted authorities, and the injured couple received medical attention. Police registered a complaint against the accused sons under relevant sections. The sons also allegedly threatened their parents regarding the land deal.

title: Mumbai killer crash on camera: Car rams bike, autos at traffic signal; woman dead
content: A car crashed into vehicles at a Mumbai traffic signal on Sunday evening.  The collision tragically killed a 34-year-old woman and injured six others.  The driver reportedly claimed he mistook the accelerator for the brake pedal.  He was arrested and later released on bail after a medical examination.  The incident has prompted demands for stricter action against the driver.

title: Gracie Hunt invests millions in wellness ahead of the new NFL season
content: Gracie Hunt, the billionaire Kansas City Chiefs’ heiress, has made a new investment as she gears up for the new season.

title: Lewis Hamilton and Kim Kardashian spark fresh buzz over relationship finances
content: Lewis Hamilton and Kim Kardashian’s relationship has sparked fresh online attention after a viral post made a surprising claim about their finances. The post alleged that Kardashian prefers paying for everything and would continue the arrangement if they eventually married. While the pair have been linked romantically and have appeared together publicly, the dramatic money claim has not been backed by a credible interview or direct statement from Hamilton.

title: Tamil Nadu to set up Olympic City, Motor Sports City: All you need to know
content: Tamil Nadu plans to build an Olympic City with advanced training facilities.  A separate Motor Sports City will host international racing events.  These projects aim to develop athletes and motorsport talent.  The initiatives will also boost tourism and create new employment opportunities.  Leading companies are expected to invest in the state's sports sector.

title: 'Intellectual dishonesty': SBI hits back at 2.6% GDP growth claim
content: The State Bank of India has challenged assertions of low nominal GDP growth, asserting that the 2.6% figure arose from inconsistent data comparisons. The bank highlights that the official real GDP growth for Q1 FY27 remains robust at 7.8%. It's common for quarterly GDP figures to be adjusted, and further revisions will continue until the data is finalized.

title: Relatives hold symbolic funerals for thousands missing as Nepal toll crosses 1,243
content: In the wake of catastrophic flash floods in the Nepal-Tibet region, the death toll has tragically reached 1,243. Rescue teams are struggling against relentless rainfall and thick debris as they search for those trapped. Prime Minister Balendra Shah has emphasized the link between this disaster and climate change on a global scale. Authorities are now initiating temporary burials for the deceased while receiving international support for identification and recovery missions.

title: Gold, silver price prediction: Will gold drop to Rs 1.4 lakh/10 gms? Check outlook
content: Gold and silver price prediction today: Gold prices are falling but buying on dips is the recommended strategy this week, says Abhilash Koikkara, Head - Forex & Commodities, Nuvama Professional Clients Group.

title: 'Ramayana Part 1': Ranbir Kapoor, Yash to meet fans ahead of Nov 6 release
content: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash will lead fan meets in Delhi and Bengaluru on October 31 and November 1 for 'Ramayana: Part One,' ahead of its recently unveiled November 6 worldwide release. A Hyderabad summit is also being planned as part of pan-India promotions for Nitesh Tiwari's epic. Sunny Deol's Lord Hanuman appearance is reportedly being kept under wraps for a climactic reveal, while a 15-minute footage preview at Big Cine Expo 2026 drew comparisons to Hollywood's 'The Lord of the Rings' for its VFX. Sony will distribute the film globally, with Prime Focus Studios handling its India release.

title: How can Bengaluru build its way out of traffic?
content: Bengaluru's ambitious tunnel road proposal underscores the urgent need for a more efficient transport system. Relying solely on mega projects won't alleviate the city's traffic woes. Enhancements to public transport, such as the Metro and buses, must prioritize commuter convenience. By refining current infrastructure and adopting advanced technology, the city can increase road network efficiency, creating a transport ecosystem that serves people, not just vehicles.

title: Tamil for Madras HC: CM Vijay to move resolution urging Centre's approval
content: In a pivotal move, Tamil Nadu's chief minister plans to introduce a resolution advocating for Tamil's recognition as a principal language. This proposal would ensure that legal rulings and decrees can be issued in Tamil, reinforcing its classical language status. It will leverage technology and appeal to current legal frameworks, echoing efforts made by the assembly in 2006 for similar recognition.

title: Bengal Civic Body Ex-Chief Arrested Over RG Kar Victim's 'Hurried Cremation'
content: The body of the female doctor of state-run R.G. Kar Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata was recovered from a seminar hall within the hospital premises on the morning of August 9, 2024.

content: The Special Cell of Delhi Police on Wednesday questioned Ashish Joshi in connection with a case allegedly related to posts involving the Election Commission.

title: Delhi-Bound Flight Lands In Lucknow After Smoke Alarm Goes Off
content: An Air India Express flight from Varanasi to Delhi made a precautionary landing at Lucknow airport Thursday morning allegedly after a smoke detection alarm went off in the aircraft's cargo hold, sources said.

title: Clean Roads, Toilets, Flower Fountains, 154 Screens: Delhi Prepares For BRICS
content: From 41 roads and 23 flower fountains to 154 digital screens and round-the-clock cleaning, the national capital is getting a major civic makeover ahead of the September 12-13 summit.

content: Officials said the actual number of dog-bite cases could be higher as some victims seek treatment at private hospitals and healthcare facilities.

title: 3-Month-Old Girl Raped By Neighbour, 35, In UP: Cops

content: India might just be building too many fighter jets to focus on any one of them well. A recalculcation is needed.

title: Boyfriend Stabs Woman To Death At Delhi Hotel, Then Tries To Die By Suicide

content: Meloni, straightforward and pragmatic, has managed to stave off the crises and defections that have toppled past governments.

title: Court Setback For MK Stalin Over Poll Defeat In Stronghold Kolathur
content: TVK's VS Babu defeated MK Stalin by 8,795 votes, polling 82,997 votes against Stalin's 74,202. Stalin, who had won Kolathur in three successive elections since the constituency was formed in 2011, finished second this time.

title: 2 Cops Shot Dead By Colleague At Border Outpost In Assam's Kamrup

title: 'Junk Borrower' Pakistan Raises $3 Billion: Economic Comeback Or False Dawn?
content: Pakistan has been trying to rebuild its economy after coming close to a default. It received an International Monetary Fund bailout in 2022.

content: "The science leaves no room for doubt: the planet is in uncharted waters, and those waters are heating up. Sea surface temperatures are rising, temperatures keep climbing, and the world is in the danger zone of extreme weather," said UN.

title: UN warns of climate risks, says 1.5°C breach likely within years
content: global temperatures are likely to cross the 1.5-degree Celsius threshold within the next few years, according to a new report released on Wednesday . the report stressed the need for immediate and sustained cuts in greenhouse gas emissions to limit the duration and magnitude of warming beyond the 1.5°C threshold .

title: ‘No country should be helping Iran’: US warns after PM Modi-Pezeshkian meet
content: u.s. secretary of state Marco Rubio warns countries against helping Iran evade sanctions, saying those that assist Tehran in generating revenue could themselves face sanctions . he says several countries maintain contact with Tehran, but stressed that Washington would take action against countries that help Iran bypass US sanctions.

title: Abhinandan Varthaman, who shot down Pak jet after Balakot strikes, joins private airline
content: abhinandan Varthaman became widely known after shooting down a pakistani fighter during an aerial engagement in 2019 before being captured by Pakistan . his move to commercial aviation comes after a distinguished career in the IAF, including his role in the aerial combat that followed India's balakot air strikes .

title: PM Modi takes stock of flood situation in Varanasi as water crosses warning mark
content: the prime minister directed the district administration to work on a war footing to provide relief to those affected . he sought detailed information from the district magistrate about the river's water level and the arrangements being made at relief camps for people affected by the floods .

title: After Google, Apple Maps changes 'Lake Ontario' name to 'Lake America' for US users
content: renaming of Lake Ontario to "Lake America" is 'ratified and binding' apple has updated the name for users in the us, making it the second major US tech company to adopt the new name . the name will appear in the united states, while users in canada will continue to see both names .

title: Thar crushes bike-borne man, woman in Delhi Cantt; both die
content:
Two people were killed after a speeding Thar rammed into their motorcycle

NEW DELHI: Two people were killed after a speeding Thar rammed into their motorcycle in Delhi Cantonment, officials said on Thursday. The victims, a man and a woman, were travelling on the motorcycle when the Thar hit them. The Thar driver was caught by local residents and handed over to the police. Police have launched an investigation into the crash. Further details about the identities of the victims and the circumstances leading to the collision are awaited.

title: US struck 60 targets as 40 vessels, 18mn barrels of oil crossed Hormuz in record day: Report
content: the operation comes amid growing risks for commercial shipping . the high-risk operation came as US forces struck nearly 60 Iranian military targets . escorted vessels carrying around 18 million barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz .

title: Nalsar row: SC strikes down BCI orders, says it has 'no power to regulate students'
content: the bar Council of India has "no statutory authority to regulate the conduct of law students" the orders were linked to the students' protest over CJI Surya Kant's proposed participation as chief guest at the university's convocation .

title: Former bureaucrat Ashish Joshi questioned by Delhi Police for 9 hours
content: the ex-civil servant was questioned by the Delhi Police Special Cell . he was allowed to leave after nine hours on Wednesday . sources say he had only been called for questioning in connection with an old case . the former controller of communications in the department of Telecommunications .

title: No role in Sarla Bhat killing, but give me death sentence: Yasin Malik
content: jammu Kashmir Liberation Front chairman Yasin Malik has denied any role in the killing of Kashmiri Pandit nurse Sarla Bhat . in the affidavit, malik also talks about divorcing his wife to spare her the life of a widow and seeks capital punishment for himself . malik has been in new Delhi’s Tihar jail since 2019 .
